briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier model race with agentic breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced reasoning models. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with superior multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Meta's Llama 4.1 show gains in coding and long-context tasks. DeepSeek R2 challenges US leads on cost-efficiency.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level with patent-pending multi-agent security.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra clusters to xAI and Google. Microsoft announces $15B Stargate Phase 2 expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first superintelligent system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium by 2028?
